title: 第2章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇整个人明明色彩鲜明得像一幅水彩画，却偏偏透着绝望的气息，仿佛他的心早已死死的关上，层层冰冻，拒绝任何人的靠近。他，明明该是天使，却不知为何幻化成地狱的魔鬼，带着冰冷与嗜血，然而却偏偏该死的魅惑人心。此刻，男人正淡淡地看着她，脸上没有一丝的波澜，他早就醒了，看了她很久，于是更加肯定，昨晚，他只是一时的疯狂，一时的情迷。他的丫头，灿烂得像个小太阳，不会这么自我放纵。“开个价吧。”男人冷冷地吐出这几个字，仿佛是故意为了羞辱她。叶芊沫一愣，继而醒悟，靠，果然是牛郎，这么极品……一定很贵吧？不过，既然都已经点了人家了，付钱是肯定的，唉，这些做皮肉生意的人也不容易啊。“那个……你要多少？”叶芊沫定了定神，小心翼翼地试探。“什么？”低沉的声音骤然冷了好几度，周围气压明显下降。“两千？”叶芊沫裹紧被子，装作无辜的样子，“我身上只有这么多现金了。”“两千？你以为我是什么？”该死的女人，最好是他理解错了她的意思，不然，她死定了。“靠，现在的牛郎怎么这么贵啊？”叶芊沫忍不住抱怨，“好吧好吧，五千，虽然你昨晚很卖力，但是明显不够温柔，建议你以后多练习一下，免得被其他的顾客投诉！”“女人，你把刚才的话再说一遍试试？”琥珀色的眸子突然变得冷冽如刀，嘴角泛起一丝嗜血的残忍，修长的手已经紧握成拳，随时可以扑过来将她撕碎！“额……”难道她错了？而这时，一旁的手机突然响了起来，很特殊的铃声，而一旁的男人立刻抓过手机去接听。“什么事？”“欧少，找到了，我们找到了！”对方似乎有些过度的兴奋了。“确定？！”琥珀色的眸子瞬间掀起万尺的巨浪。丫头，他的丫头……没有死，他就知道她的丫头不会那么轻易的离开他的，五年了，他已经整整找了她五年了！男人挂断了电话，不顾赤裸的身体，也不顾在场的叶芊沫，立刻掀被而起，从下床到穿衣服，不到一分钟的时间。“女人，还想活命的话，最好老老实实给我待在这里等我回来！”霸道的语气带着嗜血的味道，仿佛没有一点人性。叶芊沫僵硬地点点头，乖乖地坐在床上，然而当听到关门声，以及越来越远的脚步声时，猛然下床找衣服。靠，等他回来？她傻啊，刚刚那副要吃人的样子，摆明了不会善罢甘休，鬼才留在这里！酒店的另一间房间里，男人紧紧地握着手中的文件，修长的食指用力地握住那几页纸，指骨泛白！原来是她，昨晚，原来真的是他的丫头……原来她叫叶芊沫，原来那场大火她侥幸逃过了，原来冥冥之中，她还是回到了他的身边！“欧少，董事长也知道了这件事，我担心他会为了逼您娶莫小姐而对叶小姐不利！”一旁斯文而干练的助理低声地说着。而欧慕瑄冷冷一笑，“他敢？！”这次，不管付出什么代价，他也要好好的保护她，他，绝对不可以再失去她第二次！丢下所有的事情，欧慕瑄重新回到昨晚的房间，然而，房间早已是空荡荡的……“师傅，拜托你开快点！”出租车里，叶芊沫坐在副驾驶的位置，一遍遍催促着可怜的司机师傅。好吧，她知道车已经很快了，但是她要急着赶回家收拾东西啊，要赶往机场啊啊啊！非上班高峰期，路上的车辆并不多，出租车自己在不违反交通规则的情况下，尽可能的加大速度，然而却没发觉一直跟在他们身后的那两辆车正以快速的向他们靠近！黑色的跑车，带着地狱般邪恶的气息，硬生生的朝前面那辆出租车撞过去！十字路口，红灯，出租车停了下来！然而身后的车却并没有减速，而在离出租车不到一百米的距离，车上的司机突然打开车门跳了出来，于是，那两辆失控的车就这么肆无忌惮的撞了过来！而叶芊沫，根本没有察觉！车，越来越近，而死亡的气息，也越来越浓……司机看到倒车镜，猛然看到撞过来的车辆，想要离开，然而，已经太晚了！千钧一发之际，十字路口，左侧，一辆黑色的劳斯莱斯带着嗜血的狠绝，带着强劲的风，如幻影一般冲过来！下一秒……嘭！嘭！嘭！连续的碰撞，三辆车一起翻滚着撞毁马路中央的护栏，在人行道上停了下来！三辆车，已经被毁得不成样子，闷热的公路，顿时如死一般沉寂！叶芊沫惊愕地看着那三辆车，不知为何，心中却没来由的一痛，像是即将要失去什么，伴随着一丝隐隐的惶恐，脊背发凉！“刚刚好危险，差点撞到我们！”司机重重地松了一口气，惋惜地接着说，“这些不遵守交通规则的人啊，撞得这么严重，多半里面的人命也保不住了！”叶芊沫根本没听到司机的话，只用力地看向那边的马路，心很痛，痛到让她想去看看车上受伤的人是谁。而这时，绿灯亮了起来，已经见惯了车祸的司机很负责任的发动起车子，以最快的速度驶开……侧翻的车里有一个人，像是已经没有了生命，鲜红的血将身上净白的衬衣染成了血红。交警没有来，急救车也没有赶到，路过的人纷纷围了过来，看着车里的这个人！受伤很严重，然而车里的男人却倔强地保持着清醒，他，不可以就这么轻易的死去，不可以……呼，终于按时到了机场！叶芊沫提着行李，回头再看一眼自己生活了十八年的地方，马上就要离开了，法国，巴黎，时尚之都，成就她梦想的地方。临上飞机前，叶芊沫回头看了一眼这个自己生活了十几年的城市，总有一天，她会光芒万丈的回来，用最高傲的姿态面对这里的人，这是的事……
content_en: Chapter 1 Encounter in a bar The whole person is as bright as a watercolor painting, but there is an air of despair, as if his heart has been closed and frozen, refusing anyone to approach. He was clearly supposed to be an angel, but for some reason he transformed into a devil from hell. He was cold and bloodthirsty, but he was damn charming. At this moment, the man was looking at her calmly, without a trace of emotion on his face. He had woken up a long time ago and looked at her for a long time, so he was even more sure that last night, he was just temporarily crazy and infatuated. His girl, as bright as a little sun, would not be so self-indulgent. "Make a price." The man spat out these words coldly, as if he was deliberately trying to humiliate her. Ye Qianmo was stunned for a moment, then realized, Damn, he is indeed a Cowherd, such a top-notch product... it must be very expensive, right? However, since you have already ordered someone, you can definitely pay. Alas, it is not easy for these people who are in the flesh and blood business. "Um...how much do you want?" Ye Qianmo calmed down and tested carefully. "What?" The deep voice suddenly became several degrees colder, and the surrounding air pressure dropped significantly. "Two thousand?" Ye Qianmo wrapped herself tightly in the quilt and pretended to be innocent, "I only have so much cash on me." "Two thousand? What do you think I am?" Damn woman, it's best that he misunderstood her, otherwise, she would be dead. "Damn, why are Cowherds so expensive nowadays?" Ye Qianmo couldn't help complaining, "Okay, okay, five thousand, although you worked very hard last night, you were obviously not gentle enough. I suggest you practice more in the future to avoid complaints from other customers!" "Woman, can you say what you just said again?" The amber eyes suddenly became as cold as knives, and there was a hint of bloodthirsty cruelty at the corner of his mouth. His slender hands were clenched into fists, ready to pounce and tear her to pieces at any time! "Uh..." Was she wrong? At this moment, the cell phone beside him suddenly rang with a very special ringtone, and the man beside him immediately grabbed the cell phone to answer it. "What's the matter?" "Young Master Ou, we found it, we found it!" The other party seemed to be a little overly excited. "Are you sure?!" The amber eyes instantly set off a huge wave of thousands of feet. The girl, his girl... was not dead, so he knew that her girl would not leave him so easily. He has been looking for her for five years! The man hung up the phone and immediately got up regardless of his naked body or Ye Qianmo who was present. It took less than a minute to get out of bed and get dressed. "Woman, if you still want to live, you'd better stay here and wait for me to come back!" The domineering tone sounded bloodthirsty, as if there was no humanity at all. Ye Qianmo nodded stiffly and sat on the bed obediently. However, when she heard the door closing and footsteps getting farther and farther away, she suddenly got out of bed to look for clothes. Damn, wait for him to come back? She is stupid. The way she looked like she was about to eat someone just now made it clear that she would not give up. Only the devil stayed here! In another room of the hotel, the man held the document in his hand tightly, holding the pages with his long index finger so hard that his finger bones turned white! It turned out to be her. Last night, it turned out that she was really his girl... It turned out that her name was Ye Qianmo. It turned out that she escaped the fire by luck. It turned out that somehow, she still returned to him! "Young Master Ou, the chairman also knows about this. I'm worried that he will do something bad to Miss Ye in order to force you to marry Miss Mo!" the gentle and capable assistant beside him said in a low voice. And Ou Muxuan smiled coldly, "How dare he?!" This time, no matter what the cost, he must protect her well. He must not lose her a second time! Leaving everything behind, Ou Muxuan returned to the room he stayed in last night. However, the room was already empty... "Master, please drive faster!" In the taxi, Ye Qianmo sat in the passenger seat and urged the poor driver over and over again. Well, she knew the car was already very fast, but she had to rush home to pack her things and rush to the airport! During off-peak hours, there were not many vehicles on the road. The taxis were speeding up as much as possible without violating traffic rules. However, they did not realize that the two cars that had been following them were approaching them at a fast pace! The black sports car, with an aura as evil as hell, slammed into the taxi in front of it! Crossroads, red light, taxi stopped! However, the car behind him did not slow down. Less than a hundred meters away from the taxi, the driver suddenly opened the door and jumped out. As a result, the two out-of-control cars collided with each other without restraint! But Ye Qianmo didn't notice it at all! The car was getting closer and closer, and the smell of death was getting stronger and stronger... The driver saw the rearview mirror and suddenly saw the car that had hit him, and wanted to leave, but it was too late! At the critical moment, on the left side of the intersection, a black Rolls-Royce rushed over like a phantom with bloodthirsty ruthlessness and strong wind! The next second... bang! Bang! Bang! In a series of collisions, the three cars rolled together, crashed into the guardrail in the middle of the road, and stopped on the sidewalk! The three cars had been completely destroyed, and the sweltering road suddenly became as silent as death! Ye Qianmo looked at the three cars in astonishment. For some reason, her heart felt pain for no reason, as if she was about to lose something. Along with a hint of fear, she felt a chill down her spine! "It was just dangerous, they almost hit us!" The driver breathed a heavy sigh of relief and continued regretfully, "These people who don't obey traffic rules, the collision was so serious, most of the people inside may not have been saved!" Ye Qianmo didn't hear the driver's words at all, and only looked hard at the road over there. Her heart hurt, so much that she wanted to see who the injured person in the car was. At this time, the green light came on, and the driver, who was used to car accidents, started the car responsibly.
